scope: Cells A2, A3, B2, B3 of configs/jax068-grid-1km.json and their four shared seams, where the DFC2019 JAX_068 lidar reaches (about 26% of each cell). The other 12 cells have no independent reference and are labelled unmeasured.

baseline.model: jax068-2015-19v-r1 (single central 19-view recipe block): artifacts/stage1/pilot-2015-19v-recipe-01/export-r2 with depth-r2
baseline.method: pipeline.dsm_validation with --grid configs/jax068-grid-1km.json --cell <cell>; registered all-labelled MAE on the same lidar pixels as each grid cell will use

justification.cell_mae: Same-area comparison with the single-block model (lesson 1 of docs/phase3/SPLIT_RESULT.md); 0.3 m is the existing class-regression budget. The split experiment measured +0.02/+0.04 m for the same comparison.
justification.seam_band: Unchanged from the split experiment's rule (0.5 m excess over each cell's interior, ±10 m band).
justification.seam_step: Residual: the model's median height step across the seam minus the lidar's own step over the same 10 m strips (lesson 2). Limits as in the split experiment, which measured 0.33 m (ground) and 0.14 m (all).
justification.coverage: Each cell has about 26% lidar coverage (about 60,000 labelled pixels); below 20% a result is inconclusive, never a pass.

outcome: Report per cell and seam. Passing cells and seams may be activated in the app; failures are published inactive with the measurement and discussed before activation. Thresholds are not changed after training.
